summary.overview: The team finalized the referral-program launch plan, setting the launch for November 10, choosing a 200 rupee app-credit reward for both referrer and friend, and skipping the email campaign for version 1. They assigned the fraud-check implementation, share-screen mock-ups, and FAQ creation, while leaving the invite-link channel decision open for later.

topics.title: Launch date and fraud check
topics.discussed: Arjun said November 3 launch was tight because the fraud check to block self-referrals was missing; he could finish the check by November 5, allowing a launch on November 10.
topics.outcome_reasoning: The team agreed to move the launch to November 10 because the fraud check could be completed by November 5, making the later date safe.

topics.title: Reward type
topics.discussed: Rahul noted cash rewards pose legal issues and proposed 200 rupees in app credit for both the referrer and the friend; Priya accepted the proposal.
topics.outcome_reasoning: They decided on 200 rupees app credit for both parties because cash rewards were a legal headache.

topics.title: Share screen mock-ups and FAQ
topics.discussed: Meera offered to create share-screen mock-ups by next Wednesday and also take the FAQ page, but Priya said mock-ups mattered more and would write the FAQ herself, completing it by November 7.
options_considered: Meera does both mock-ups and FAQ
Priya writes FAQ while Meera focuses on mock-ups
topics.outcome_reasoning: Priya took the FAQ task so Meera could deliver the mock-ups on schedule.

topics.title: Email campaign
topics.discussed: Rahul had prepared an email campaign for existing users; Priya suggested skipping the email for version 1 and testing an app promotion first.
topics.outcome_reasoning: The team chose to skip the email campaign for version 1 to focus on app promotion first.

topics.title: Invite link distribution channel
topics.discussed: Meera asked whether the invite link should be sent via WhatsApp or SMS; Arjun said WhatsApp is easier, SMS works for everyone; Rahul leaned toward WhatsApp but lacked data; Priya deferred the decision to next week after data is collected.
topics.outcome_reasoning: No decision was made; the team will revisit the choice next week once data is available.
